confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors are grounded in crowd-sourced aggregator averages and budget guides of uncertain date, cross-checked against each other and tourist-zone ranges, so they are moderate quality. Cocktail is a bounded estimate from scattered margarita reports across venues. No usable wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine_glass is derived from the local beer relationship (roughly 2.7x the draft beer anchor) and is less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. A hostel-price search was run in error despite the no-accommodation-search instruction; its results were only loosely considered as a sanity check and no accommodation value was taken from them. FX: the 2026-10-16 observation comes from the RBA exchange-rates page as surfaced in search results (which also listed 0.7002 for 14 Oct and 0.6955 for 15 Oct), corroborated by a third-party page citing RBA data. I did not open the RBA F11.1 table directly, so verify the official value there before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is Los Cabos / Cabo San Lucas resort-town pricing for Mexico's Pacific tourist corridor, with restaurant and beer anchors set against aggregator averages and budget-guide ranges, and accommodation set holistically from general knowledge.
